note: The two sets are nearly identical in content, quotes, and bindings; both capture the 5 rpm minimum speed with its 3P rationale, the 7.55 rpm rated speed at 10.59 m/s, 95 m/s tip speed, pitch schedule, Region 2.5 negligibility, and the DTU quadratic gain scheduling. The only substantive difference is how the two control-region headings are framed: A records the wind-speed range as the value with the mode label as a condition, while B records the mode label as the value with the range as a condition — both are defensible readings of the same heading text. Both sets contain the same minor duplication of pitch and speed claims and the same slightly inferred condition 'at rated rotational speed' for the 95 m/s tip speed, so neither gains an advantage.
